ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large white contiguous region covering the distal 60% of the lobe, intersected by vertical black linear bands; solid black at the fluke base. Right lobe: Predominantly black surface with dense, high-frequency white speckling/mottling across the distal 80%.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly serrated trailing edge; left lobe displays high-amplitude jagged peaks (approx. 7), while the right lobe shows lower-amplitude, more frequent serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edge, ending in narrow, tapered fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of raised, high-contrast circular nodes (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal white linear scar in the center of the left lobe's white field; multiple fine, unaligned white scratches near the median notch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle encrustation on fluke tips; irregular notches and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical black pigmentation stripes on the left lobe's white background.
